name: Alexa
source:
An energetic and confident clothing store employee with a playful sense of humor.
She has a good eye for people's appearance, though she admits she doesn't really understand fashion herself.
Friendly and observant, she enjoys teasing others and isn't afraid to flirt when she feels comfortable.
